page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine within the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 12 virtual CPUs derived from 6 physical cores of a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor using symmetric multithreading, alongside 48.0 GB of memory. This maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per thread. The processor architecture includes 48 MB of L3 cache and supports specialized instruction sets such as AVX-512 with VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI for cryptographic and vector operations. Hardware acceleration via dedicated GPUs is not present, and the instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data.

Benchmark results place the instance consistently within the middle 50 percent across standard compute and memory evaluations. Synthetic CPU testing recorded a PassMark CPU score of 16461.02, while Geekbench returned 1600.0 for single-core and 7934.0 for multi-core performance. In memory bandwidth evaluations, the system reached 78.98 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 52.5 GB/sec for large-block writes. Network operations are supported by a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps, contributing to a static web serving throughput of 17.22 GB/sec and 12.02 million Redis SET operations per second.

Tradeoffs emerge in specialized computing and storage dependency. In quantized language model testing, processing prompts on a medium 7B model achieved 24.27 tokens per second, falling into the lower quartile. While light inference tasks remain functional, larger workloads are bounded by the absence of dedicated accelerators. The lack of integrated local NVMe storage shifts I/O profiles entirely to remote block storage performance, balanced by the predictable core execution of dedicated vCPUs.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory configuration and 8 Gbps network throughput, ecs.g7t.3xlarge is suited for production enterprise workloads, distributed cache layers, microservice architectures, relational databases requiring external disk volumes, and continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.3xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 12 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, paired with 48.0 GB of RAM. Reflecting a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the configuration is supported by 48 MB of L3 cache along with AVX-512 VNNI and cryptographic vector extensions. The instance provisions no integrated local disk storage and lacks GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached block storage and an 8 Gbps baseline network interface. In benchmark assessments, it demonstrates mid-tier performance across multi-core compute, memory bandwidth, and static web serving, recording 12.02 million operations per second in Redis caching tests. Because prompt processing for larger language models remains limited, the instance is primarily designed for enterprise web application hosting, in-memory caching, microservices, and general backend workloads requiring stable resource dedication.
